text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I came to the racecourse with Curren Chan today.
Our goal was to watch the races, and...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WAAAAAAAHHHH!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Waah, what a wonderful stage♪
The crowd is totally hyped up too~!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
It's only just started, but...
somehow Curren is already getting super fired up♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: To better understand how their dancing actually looks from the audience's perspective—and to raise their awareness once more—they came to observe the live stage.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ah, even Curren recognizes this chorus♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOO--!! KYAAA---!)

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Onii-chan.
Curren wants to dance too~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Onee-chan.
Curren wants to dance too~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: I feel like I could dance really well right now. I'll make sure not to bother anyone around me...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: So... pleeease? Pretty please?
choice_data_list: If we're going to dance, let's change spots.
No, let's just focus on observing properly.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Yay~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, we moved to a quiet park
with fewer people around, but—

text_block_list.name: Passing Woman
text_block_list.text:
—Eh!? Who is that girl,
she's super cute!

text_block_list.name: Man Jogging
text_block_list.text:
An angel! There's an angel right here—!!
Woooaaahhh—!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The moment Curren Chan began to dance,
a sudden stir rippled through the surrounding crowd.
Her cuteness today is even beyond its usual level...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Ehe♪ Maybe I should get even more serious~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—If you do that,
it'll only cause even more chaos!!!!
choice_data_list: L-let's call it a day for now!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh... Why not~...?
You're so mean, Onii-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh... Why not~...?
You're so mean, Onee-chan~.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Still... it was fun, so I'll forgive you♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Never let Curren Chan dance carelessly in a public setting.
That was yet another lesson I learned today.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~! Big bro,
you're so strict today~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Ehh~! Big sis,
you're so strict today~...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, please. Curren wants
to sparkle too... Kyururun☆

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Curren Chan gazes up at me with moist, pleading eyes...
But this is for her own good! I can't back down here—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Such incredible resolve...?
Onii-chan... you really care that much...?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Such incredible resolve...?
Onee-chan... you really care that much...?"

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Still, even Curren...!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
*Haa*... *haa*...
Kyu-ru-ru... kyu-ru-run...☆

text_block_list.name: Umamusume on Stage
text_block_list.text:
—Everyooone,
thank you so much for today!

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: No way... Is it really that late already...?

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I see... You've become so strong,
big brother...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
I see... You've become so strong,
big sister...

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, Curren's starting to have
a little bit too much fun with this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As Curren Chan said that, a fierce fighting spirit
flared up within her eyes...!
